title: Across

inlines.v: ACROSS', preposition akraus'. [a and cross. See Cross.] 1. From side to side, opposed to along, which is in the direction of the length; athwart; quite over; as, a bridge is laid across a river. 2. Intersecting; passing over at any angle; as a line passing across another.
